name: Encouraging Each Other
overview: Scripture reveals that encouraging one another is vital for spiritual health and mutual growth. A timely, uplifting word can bring joy and lighten heavy hearts, while the fellowship of believers sharpens and strengthens each other, much like iron sharpens iron. Bearing each other's burdens fulfills Christ's law, and wholesome speech builds up and ministers grace. Together, believers are empowered to abound in hope and peace through the work of the Holy Spirit.
